test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**in**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence aims to describe the time frame over which a certain number of white tigers have been spotted in India. The preposition that fits best depends on the context of time.
 
• '**In**' is the correct preposition to use when expressing a period of time during which something happens or has happened. The phrase "**in the last one-hundred years**" correctly indicates that the spotting of twelve white tigers occurred during this time period.
 
• Using '**in**' provides a clear understanding that the observation of the white tigers took place over the span of the last one hundred years, not confined to any point or specific moment but throughout this duration.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

Complete Passage: *The white tiger is an offspring of Bengal tiger, which has the necessary gene for white colouring. It has beautiful black stripes on the__ white coat. __This__ species of animal has blue eyes and a pink nose.*

*A pure white tiger is totally white without any stripes, which is due to the presence of double recessive allele in the genetic code. It happens only in the Bengal tiger subspecies, and only one in 10,000 births can have it naturally. White tigers are rarely seen in the wild, and only twelve of them have been spotted in India __in__ the last one-hundred years. Tigers have a lifespan of 10-15 years. They are (4) _______ animals, and are fond of hunting at night. Their diet consists of any animals that they can catch, and can eat up to 40 pounds of meat at one time. After such a big meal, they usually remain away for several days from food. They are slow runners, (5) ______ good swimmers. They are poor climbers and cannot climb a tree easily. They live in an area ranging from 10 to 30 square miles depending upon the availability of prey, water and shelter. Habitat loss, poaching and expansion of the human population have together contributed to their becoming endangered. They are widely hunted for their body-parts, which are used in traditional Chinese medicines.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1)** 'following' typically suggests something that comes after a specific event or point in time, and it is not the best choice for indicating something that happens within a specific duration.
 
• **Option 2) **'next to' is mainly used to describe physical proximity or positioning and does not relate to the concept of time, making it inappropriate for this context.
 
• **Option 3)** 'behind' is also used to indicate physical location or to indicate something is overdue or delayed, which does not suit the intended meaning of happening throughout a period of time.
